quotes.text: One well-chosen question, attempted with full attention, is worth more than ten rushed guesses.
The moment you stop tracking time and start tracking your thinking, something shifts.
Preparation is not about covering everything. It is about knowing what you know.
A calm beginning to a practice session is a strategy, not a luxury.
Every section you analyse honestly brings you one step closer to the score you can actually achieve.
The questions you skip wisely are as important as the ones you solve correctly.
Steady, consistent effort in the final stretch counts for more than a frantic sprint.
Understanding why an answer is wrong teaches you more than confirming a correct one.
Data from your own practice is the most honest coach you will ever have.
The exam tests decisions under pressure. Practice is where you learn to make better decisions.
